name: Unscrupulous diner's dilemma
summary: N diners agree to split the bill equally, each then chooses between an expensive and cheap dish.
rules_text: Players are n diners who have agreed to split the total check equally. Simultaneously and without communication, each privately chooses Cheap or Expensive. Let l be cost of cheap, k cost of expensive (k>l), b joy of cheap, a joy of expensive, with k-l > a-b, b-l > a-k, and a-k/n > b-l/n. After all choices, let x be sum of chosen dish costs. Each player i who chose cost c_i gets utility = joy_i - x/n, where joy_i is a if Expensive else b. The game ends after one choice. Higher utility is better.
rating_reason: n-player prisoner's dilemma, simultaneous choice, arithmetic payoff.
